text: Marie Curie studied at the University of Paris. Pierre Curie collaborated with Marie Curie. Marie Curie discovered radium with Pierre Curie.
Ada Lovelace worked with Charles Babbage on the Analytical Engine. Charles Babbage designed the Analytical Engine. Ada Lovelace wrote detailed notes about the machine.
The Nile flows through Egypt. Cairo is the capital of Egypt. Alexandria is a major city in Egypt.
